test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into segments. Identify the segment that contains an error. If you don’t find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

People admired him, for / he lived by the same principals / that he preached.

options.text: he lived by the same principals

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect spelling of the word "**principles**." It should be "**principles**" instead of "**principals**."
 
• "Principals" refers to the heads of schools, whereas "principles" refers to fundamental truths or beliefs.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**he lived by the same principles**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"People admired him, for he lived by the same principles that he preached."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "that he preached."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 3.
 
• 4: "People admired him, for" – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
